answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 48 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in tundra, verified in tide, and bridge names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That bill is paid per identity, so 367 aliases cost 58 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
